Bring your Hevy history

Import your sessions for free. Use a CSV export, or a Hevy API key to bring routines and folders too.

Free

Import a CSV

In Hevy, open Profile > Settings > Export & Import Data > Export Data > Export Workouts. Save the file to Files on your iPhone.

In Block, open Plan > New workout > Import from Hevy, or open the import from Settings. Tap Choose Hevy CSV and select the file.

The CSV brings your sessions. Under Reuse as workouts, choose the workouts you want to lift again. Block creates each from its latest session.

Use a Hevy API key

A key brings your sessions and routines, with their folders. The key is a Hevy Pro feature. Get it from Hevy's developer settings.

In the Block import, paste the key and tap Fetch from Hevy. Block uses it for this import and does not store it.

Check every exercise match

Review the exercise matches before anything saves. A lift may have a different name in Block. Tap a match to choose another library exercise or create a custom exercise.

Tap Import and keep Block open until it finishes. Nothing changes in Hevy. If the import stops, run it again: Block skips sessions already imported.

Your history becomes your progress

Imported sessions contribute to your records and charts. Open Progress to browse them. Workouts made from the import are in Plan, ready to edit or lift.

Imported sessions show no lamps. With Block Pro, the latest imported session of each workout you keep is judged against that workout. The AI trainer (Pro, iOS 27) can propose next targets from it, for you to approve.

Creating a training block from the imported workouts needs Pro. Logging the workouts and keeping your history are free.
